text:
ashley: quick sync — we need a lightweight rule set for SI co-sell leads coming from cloud marketplaces and HW partners. getting too many duplicates in SFDC.
jorge: yes please. main pain: marketplace leads show up as both partner & inbound web form. who owns first-touch?
maria: current practice is first-touch owns lead for 14 days, but its not enforced and lobbed back and forth. we should codify for SIs specifically.
kelvin: recommend: partner owns discovery + demo scheduling for 21 days if they have an active opportunity in the partner portal. otherwise, claim reverts to field AE.
ashley: sounds reasonable — proposal: marketplace/hw partner lead routing rules:
- if partner registers lead in portal -> partner owner assigned and 21-day exclusive claim.
- if lead originates via redwood.com + partner referral tag -> assign to partner for 7 days to validate, else AE owns.
- duplicate detection: auto-merge if email match and mark as "partner-claimed" so ops can audit.
jorge: need an escalation path: if partner hasnt engaged in 7 days, AE gets ping and can auto-claim after 7 more days. also reassign rules for >$250k ARR deals (immediate field-owner).
lisa: legal/contract note: always include a clause in the partner registration flow that confirms consent to share contact and to be contacted by Redwood AEs. otherwise we get privacy issues when reassigning.
maria: ops action items: I will add a label taxonomy: [partner-portal, partner-referral, hw-channel, marketplace-sku]. Also add an audit field: partner_engaged_ts.
partners-bot: reminder: new partner portal entries -> #partner-ingest (automated) posted at 1968000025
kelvin: technical: for auto-routing we can implement simple routing rules in the intake worker. Pseudocode we discussed yesterday:
```
if lead.source == "partner_portal":
  assign(lead, partner.owner)
  set_claim_expiry(lead, now + 21d)
elif lead.tags contains "partner-referral":
  assign(lead, partner.owner)
  set_claim_expiry(lead, now + 7d)
else:
  assign(lead, AE.oncall)
```
ashley: thanks — Maria can you draft the short playbook snippet (one-pager) with these rules + escalation matrix? I'll loop in partnerships legal and sales ops.
maria: on it. will put draft in Confluence and ping this thread.
jorge: can we also add a small QoS rule for HW partners: if lead references a hardware SKU and support required, auto-cc solutions engineering (SE) and partner AM.
kelvin: yes — will wire SE auto-cc based on sku prefix.
lisa: I'll add the consent language to the registration form, send you the snippet.
ashley: timeline: draft by EOD Wednesday, feedback by Friday. if everyone thumbs-up we ship minimal automation next week (:thumbsup: = go).
jorge: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
partners-bot: scheduled 7-day follow-up reminder set for 1968006041
ashley: great work team — keeping this lightweight so we can iterate. I'll post the final play and a checklist for partner onboarding.
